description: Create an unpaid order when the user asks to book one offer from get_hotel_offers. It takes items, one item with the offer's offerId inside it (nowhere else in the arguments) and hotel.rooms, and contact. The answer is the order, awaiting payment: its reference, the total, the stay and its terms, and a payment link, a Fortrip page to pay on. Nothing is charged until the order is paid, on that page or with pay_order; anyone holding the link can pay. Send the contact and, for each room of the offer, at least one guest. If the price or terms changed since the offer, the answer is offer_changed with every change and a new offer: show the changes and ask the user again before ordering it. Sending the same details again returns the same order. An offer is ordered once: another order of the stay (another party, or a corrected guest name or contact) takes a new offer. cancel_order cancels or closes an order; for changes, or a cancellation it can't make, the user emails support@fortrip.ai with the order's reference.

contact.description: Who the hotel and the confirmation reach.

email.description: Contact email; the confirmation is sent here.

name.description: Contact person's full name, in any script, at most 119 characters.

phone.description: Contact phone number, with country code.

items.description: What to order: exactly one item, which holds the offer's offerId and what its hotel needs to know. The offerId goes inside the item, not beside items.

hotel.description: What the hotel needs to know.

rooms.description: One entry per room of the offer, in order: as many entries as the offer has rooms, not one per adult.

guests.description: Guests staying in this room: at least one, no more than the room sleeps. List only the guests the user named; one is enough, even when more adults share the room.

firstName.description: Guest's first name, in Latin letters as on the passport; transliterate accents (Müller → Mueller).

lastName.description: Guest's last name, in Latin letters as on the passport.

specialRequests.description: Requests for the hotel, in English. Not guaranteed.

offerId.description: The offer to order: an offerId from an offers response. It goes here, inside the item, and nowhere else in the request.

name: create_order
title: Create order
